en: Click Spell 1, then pick a spot on the field to summon.
Summoning always needs an offering. This zombie costs 1 Corpse and 1 Gore.
Click your unit to select it and see its stats.
With a unit selected, right-click the ground. It takes a short walk from where it stands.
The red bar is health. The blue bar fills up until the unit thinks again. The yellow bar is its current animation.

How fast a unit thinks depends on its [b]CPU[/b] (Corpses Per Unit). How fast it moves and animates depends on its [b]GPU[/b] (Gores Per Unit). Both come from what you offer when summoning, and you can tune them later.
Giving a new order doesn't stop the old one. It joins a queue instead. Try it!
Remembering lots of orders takes Remembers As Monster, or [b]RAM[/b]. When RAM is full, the unit freezes and can't do anything.
You can Sacrifice that unit to get part of its offering back.
Time to cast some magic. Click the Necronomicon to open the spell book.
A spell has two parts: Summoning, which picks what you summon and what you offer, and Thinking, which is how your unit behaves.
Click Summoning to choose which creature this spell summons and how much it costs. [b]CPU[/b] and [b]GPU[/b] also change the unit's [b]RAM[/b].

Now click Thinking to shape how your unit behaves. Runes come in two kinds: conditions and actions. When a condition is true, the runes inside it run. An action rune adds that action to the queue. A spell reads from top to bottom, as fast as the unit's [b]CPU[/b] allows. Each rune also costs [b]MB[/b] (Monster Brain), which takes up [b]RAM[/b], so don't stack too many.
Your goal is to wipe out every villager on the field. Shape your units however you like to get the upper hand. Now, use everything you have to win!
You wiped out the villagers! You earned resources and new runes to write more spells. Press Back to world to begin your plan to conquer the world!
